records.name: Acrobatics
records.description: Balance, tumbling and escaping a hold. Landing well, and getting free.

records.name: Alertness
records.description: Noticing that something is off — a sound behind you, or a lie in front of you. **Resists Persuade.**

records.name: Appraise
records.description: Knowing what a thing is worth before anyone names a price.

records.name: Archaeology
records.description: Reading ruins, artefacts and the people who left them.

records.name: Athletics
records.description: Climbing and jumping. Getting your body somewhere it was not.

records.name: Awareness
records.description: Spotting what is hidden and searching where it might be. **Opposes Stealth.**

records.name: Beast Handling
records.description: Riding, calming and directing animals.

records.name: Botany
records.description: Plant and soil analysis. *Astromechs run samples; Ithorians read a forest.*

records.name: Demolitions
records.description: Placing charges and defusing someone else's. **Spends mines; the skill sets grade and radius.**

records.name: Intimidate
records.description: Making someone believe the cost of refusing. **Resisted differently from Persuade** — see `SKILL-RESOLUTION-01 §3.1`.

records.name: Medicine
records.description: Treating injury. **The roll answers how much a medpac restores**, not whether it works.

records.name: Mysticism
records.description: The Force as a subject of study — traditions, relics and what the untrained call superstition.

records.name: Persuade
records.description: Changing a mind that was made up. **Rolled against the target's Alertness** — *can they see through you?*

records.name: Pilot
records.description: Flying a ship, and knowing where to point it.

records.name: Repair
records.description: Restoring damaged equipment and droids. **Spends parts by damage — and a droid repairing itself restores more.**

records.name: Scavenging
records.description: Finding value in wreckage, and food where there is none. **⚠ Reduces ration use only where a package tracks rations.**

records.name: Science
records.description: Laboratory analysis, chemistry and physical theory.

records.name: Security
records.description: Opening what was locked against you — locks, traps and sealed doors as one job. **Spikes grant a bonus, not access.**

records.name: Sleight of Hand
records.description: Taking something without the hand being seen.

records.name: Slicing
records.description: Getting into a closed system, and forging what comes out of it. **Spends spikes by terminal grade.**

records.name: Stealth
records.description: Moving unseen and unheard, as one act. **Opposed by Awareness** — see `§4`.

records.name: Streetwise
records.description: Knowing who to ask, and passing for someone who belongs. **Spends credits; higher skill means cheaper informants.**

records.name: Fly
records.description: ⚠ **Beast only.** Does not appear on a character's skill list.

records.name: Survival
records.description: Tracking, foraging, shelter, and reading terrain and weather.

records.name: Swim
records.description: Moving through water, and staying above it.

records.name: Xenology
records.description: Species, cultures and how to deal with something that does not think as you do.
